---
name: Feature
about: Issue template (mirrors TASKS.md format — issues live there until a GitHub remote exists)
---

## Goal
What this issue accomplishes.

## Scope
What is included.

## Non-goals
What must not be touched.

## Done when
Concrete, testable acceptance criteria.

## Tasks
- [ ] Write failing test
- [ ] Implement minimal code
- [ ] Run targeted test
- [ ] Run full pytest
- [ ] Update docs if API/config changed
